characters.notes: Not physically present. Owns an old map that Perrin recalls, though he says it's not too accurate. Rand and Mat mooned over it more than Perrin did.

appearances.whereabouts: East bank of the Arinelle River, in a small copse of cedar trees, then traveling downriver to find Egwene in a stand of trees with a hemlock
appearances.notable_actions: Wakes from exhausted sleep under cedar branches; scouts the riverbank cautiously; finds Egwene's trail via hoofprints; reunites with her; proposes a plan to go to Caemlyn rather than Whitebridge to wait for Moiraine; takes leadership role in decision-making; decides they should start moving immediately
appearances.demeanor: Initially cautious and anxious about Trollocs and Fades; relieved to find Egwene; thoughtful and deliberate in planning; surprisingly confident in taking the lead despite expecting Egwene to take charge; practical and determined

appearances.whereabouts: In a dense stand of trees with a hemlock on the east bank of the Arinelle, where she made camp with a fire
appearances.notable_actions: Survived the river crossing with Bela's help; made a camp with a fire; nearly attacked Perrin with a club before recognizing him; fed him bread and cheese; deferred to his plan to go to Caemlyn; expressed confidence that Moiraine will find them
appearances.demeanor: Initially defensive and wary when Perrin enters her camp; relieved to see him alive; concerned for his wet condition; surprisingly willing to follow Perrin's lead rather than challenging him; hopeful about Moiraine finding them

appearances.whereabouts: In Egwene's camp in the stand of trees on the east bank of the Arinelle
appearances.notable_actions: Carried Egwene across the river safely; headed away from the Trollocs and towed Egwene along

relationships.description: Close friends and companions from the Two Rivers, separated from their group and now traveling together; Egwene unusually defers to Perrin's leadership
Perrin wishes they could do without her but recognizes they need her protection; hopes she will find them as she promised
Egwene has confidence that Moiraine Sedai will find them and trusts in her promise
Bela is Egwene's horse who saved her by swimming across the river with her
Master Luhhan is Perrin's master blacksmith; Perrin worked at his forge and dreams of it
Friends from the Two Rivers, separated and worried about each other
Friends from the Two Rivers, separated
Egwene expresses particular concern for Rand's safety, saying 'Rand has to be all right' first before adding the others
